main.summary: Stores transfer metadata and durable publish state independently from payload bytes.

method.name: LoadRecoveryStateForAdminAsync
method.summary: Loads a consistent administrative snapshot of one session, its publication journal, and its persisted transfer ranges and chunks.
method.returns: The recovery snapshot; its session is null when the session does not exist.

method.name: LoadStaleTransferSessionCandidatesAsync
method.summary: Loads a bounded cursor page of tenant-scoped sessions whose last server-observed activity is at or before a fixed cleanup cutoff.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the candidates.
Inclusive activity cutoff for this scan.
Exclusive cursor from the preceding page for the same catalog, or null for the first page.
Maximum number of lightweight candidates to return.
method.returns: The next stale-session candidate page.

method.name: HasDependentSessionAsync
method.summary: Checks whether the catalog contains any staged-read or stream-follow session that depends on the specified source session.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the dependent session.
method.returns: True when a dependent session exists and the source must be retained.

method.name: HasPublicationJournalAsync
method.summary: Checks whether the catalog contains publication recovery state for the specified transfer session.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the journal.
method.returns: True when publication state exists and session closure must be refused.

method.name: DeleteJournalsForInstanceAsync
method.summary: Deletes publication journals only for one catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the journals.
method.returns: True when one or more matching journals were removed.

method.name: TouchTransferSessionAsync
method.summary: Advances the server-observed activity timestamp for one catalog and item-scoped session without changing its manifest or transfer state version.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the session.
method.returns: True when the matching session was touched.

method.name: LoadJournalsForInstanceAsync
method.summary: Loads publication journal states for one catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the journals.
method.returns: Matching journal states.

method.name: PurgeRecoveryStateAsync
method.summary: Conditionally deletes one session's publication journal and session state when its recorded freshness values still match.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must own the session.
Expected item identifier for the session.
Expected session state version from the inspection snapshot.
Expected journal operation identifier, or null when no journal exists.
Expected journal phase, or null when no journal exists.
Expected journal update time, or null when no journal exists.
method.returns: True when the expected state was deleted; otherwise false.

method.name: LoadSessionAsync
method.summary: Loads one transfer session when it belongs to the specified catalog.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must own the session.
method.returns: The transfer session, or null when it does not exist in the catalog.

method.name: LoadStreamChunkAsync
method.summary: Loads one immutable stream append chunk at the specified offset when its session belongs to the catalog.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must own the session.
method.returns: The chunk at that offset, or null when none exists.

method.name: LoadSessionsAsync
method.summary: Loads transfer sessions for the required catalog using indexed server-side filters.
method.param: Indexed filters with a required authorized CatalogName.
method.returns: The sessions matching the filters.

method.name: LoadSessionsForAdminAsync
method.summary: Loads transfer sessions across catalogs for an admin-authorized inventory operation.
method.returns: The sessions matching the filters across catalogs.

method.name: SaveSessionAsync
method.summary: Creates or updates one transfer session without changing its owning catalog or immutable identity.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must match the session manifest.
method.returns: A task representing the persistence operation.

method.name: DeleteSessionAsync
method.summary: Deletes one transfer session only when it belongs to the specified catalog.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must own the session.
method.returns: True when a session in the catalog was deleted.

method.name: FindOpenConflictAsync
method.summary: Finds the newest writer session in a catalog that blocks a new transfer for an item.
method.returns: The blocking open conflict, or null when no conflict exists.

method.name: LoadSegmentedRangesAsync
method.summary: Loads all realized ranges for a segmented transfer in the specified catalog.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must own the session.
method.returns: The realized ranges ordered by their accepted ordinal.

method.name: LoadSegmentedCoverageAsync
method.summary: Loads merged coverage intervals for a session in the authorized catalog.
method.returns: Coverage intervals ordered by offset.

method.name: LoadSegmentedRangeAsync
method.summary: Loads an individual segment at an exact offset.
method.returns: The matching segment or null.

method.name: IsSegmentedRangeCoveredAsync
method.summary: Checks whether merged coverage contains the entire requested range.
method.returns: True when the range is covered.

method.name: HasSegmentedRangeOverlapAsync
method.summary: Checks whether the requested range intersects merged coverage.
method.returns: True when the range overlaps coverage.

method.name: CommitSegmentedRangeAsync
method.summary: Atomically commits a verified segmented range and updated manifest only when the persisted session item instance token matches, or recognizes an identical retry for that instance.
method.param: Verified range to persist or compare.
Session state with the proposed range coverage and version.
Session version on which the write was based.
Authorized catalog name that must own the parent session.
method.returns: The committed, replayed, or rejected range with authoritative version.

method.name: LoadStreamChunksAsync
method.summary: Loads all immutable append chunks for a stream transfer in the specified catalog.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must own the session.
method.returns: The append chunks ordered by their accepted ordinal.

method.name: CommitStreamAppendAsync
method.summary: Atomically commits a verified stream chunk and its updated session manifest only when the persisted session item instance token matches, or recognizes an identical retry at an occupied offset for that instance.
method.param: Verified append chunk state to persist or compare.
Session state with the proposed appended length and version.
Session version on which the append was based.
Authorized catalog name that must own the parent session.
method.returns: The committed or replayed append result with authoritative progress.

method.name: LoadJournalAsync
method.summary: Loads one durable publication journal only when it belongs to the specified catalog.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must own the journal.
method.returns: The publication journal, or null when it does not exist in the catalog.

method.name: LoadRecoverableJournalCandidatesAsync
method.summary: Loads a bounded page of lightweight journal candidates before a fixed scan cutoff.
method.param: Inclusive update-time cutoff for the scan.
Exclusive keyset cursor from the previous page, if any.
Maximum number of candidates to return.
method.returns: The next page of candidates.

method.name: SaveJournalAsync
method.summary: Creates or updates one durable publication journal only when its catalog and item instance token match the parent transfer session.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must own the journal.
method.returns: A task representing the persistence operation.

method.name: PromoteStagedReadSessionAsync
method.summary: Atomically promotes an existing segmented staged-read follow session to published-read mode when its source and catalog match.
method.param: Published-read state to persist for the existing staged-read session.
Expected source session identifier of the staged-read session.
Authorized catalog name that must own the session.
method.returns: True when the existing eligible session was promoted; otherwise false.

method.name: DeleteJournalAsync
method.summary: Deletes one durable publication journal only when it belongs to the specified catalog.
method.param: Authorized catalog name that must own the journal.
method.returns: True when a journal in the catalog was deleted.
